column1: # Official media to fetch from the Internet Archive and, when asked, extract
# name <TAB> archive.org item <TAB> file pattern <TAB> corpus output dir <TAB> action
# A push that changes this file starts .github/workflows/import-media.yml,
# which fetches every entry that is not in sources/ yet, inventories it, and
# imports the documentation pages of the entries whose action is `import`.
# The medium itself is kept verbatim under sources/<name>/ with a
# PROVENANCE.md; already fetched media is never downloaded twice, and an
# windows-ce-2.0-sdk: Microsoft Windows CE Platform SDK (H/PC) 2.0 (02/98).
# This is the CE 2.0 SDK whose "Books Online" the corpus has been looking for
# since the CE 2.0 Technical Information CD turned out to carry no API
# `inventory` first: the medium is fetched and listed, then the action is
# changed to `import` once it is clear which files inside are documentation.
